Hi team — I reviewed the Northbridge tracked-redline and put together a short redline matrix (redline_matrix.xlsx) with risk buckets and recommended positions. Summary: 

Top items and recommended approach:
- Liability cap: ask for fee-based cap (12 months of fees) + carveouts for wilful misconduct; counterproposal: 12x fees capped at $3M. If they insist on $5M we should seek reciprocal indemnities and tighter warranty language.
- Audit rights: allow for scoped, not continuous audits; request customer to use 30-day notice and for Redwood to provide logs or summary reports where possible.
- HIPAA / BAA: Redwood supports BAA via our Privacy team — we can provide a standard BAA but will need to validate which internal regions/processes handle PHI. Marissa, please confirm the EU/PHI routing question.
- PO / invoicing: we can accept PO on invoice but require standard payment terms (Net 30).

Next steps I recommend:
1) Legal intake call with Elena on Tue 8/3 10:30 PT — Diego & Priyom + Marissa (optional)
2) We provide a redline-counterproposal (tracked) by EOD Wed 8/4; if negotiation requires >2 material deviations we escalate to Director Legal for approval.
3) Prepare a short MPO (mutual action plan) in Drive so procurement has milestones (we can attach to HubSpot).

I attached the redline_matrix.xlsx with line-item rationale and an owner for each item. I’ll prepare a tracked MSA counter by Wed and share the Drive link.
